programme.title: Mahogany

programme.title: The Wrecking Crew

programme.title: Earth vs. the Flying Saucers

programme.title: Blondie in Society

programme.title: Northwest Frontier

programme.desc: An outlaw gets even with the Wells Fargo agent who put him in prison by making him the target of bounty hunters.
programme.title: Gunfight in Black Horse Canyon

programme.desc: S01 E24 — Forget No More Stacy Morgan tells Stoney she has been following the rodeo circuit to find her father; Stoney learns that her father was actually killed in a riding accident four years earlier and that she witnessed it.
programme.title: Stoney Burke

programme.desc: The owner and operator of a rodeo that's an antiquated touring company on its last legs gets an offer from her business rival, to combine their operations -- if she will also consent to be his bride.
programme.title: Lights of Old Santa Fe

programme.desc: Spouses (Irene Dunne, Cary Grant) try to spoil each other's chances for romance before their divorce becomes final in 90 days.

programme.desc: A St. Louis lawyer's (Leon Ames) family (Judy Garland, Margaret O'Brien) stays in town for the 1904 World's Fair.
programme.title: Meet Me in St. Louis

programme.desc: An English girl's dream of racing her horse in the Grand National thunders to reality with the help of a former jockey.
programme.title: National Velvet

programme.desc: Two brothers (Spencer Tracy, Robert Wagner) climb to a plane crash in the Alps: one to help, the other to loot.
programme.title: The Mountain

programme.desc: In order to help bring Nazis to justice, a U.S. agent brings a traitor's daughter to Rio de Janeiro to seduce an exiled Nazi.
programme.title: Notorious

programme.title: The Disorderly Orderly

programme.title: The Great Escape

programme.desc: S01 E09 — Husbands Once Removed Without a marriage certificate to prove they're married, Blondie takes advantage of the situation to make Dagwood court her a second time.

programme.desc: A Broadway producer (Zero Mostel) and his accountant (Gene Wilder) back a sure-fire flop: "Springtime for Hitler."

programme.desc: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).
